summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K on August 26, 2026, reporting unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results. Total revenues were RMB690.1 million (US$101.7 million), with a net loss of RMB37.4 million versus net income of RMB72.5 million a year earlier. The filing includes operational commentary on revenue mix, cost management, and share repurchases. This is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring. There are no deal terms, premium, or transaction mechanics to analyze.
